src/game/save_file_list.hpp.reason: Indeterminate malloc-sentinel content is exposed as optional FileInfo in the game API; list allocation, alias and release contracts are not fully separated/qualified. Preserve partial append/read and link semantics while resolving these boundaries.
src/game/save_file_list.hpp.semantic_justification: All Reader overloads/decoding fields and list/search/load/free bodies were read. Decode is inverse little-endian 1392 bytes including explicit padding. First append allocates only a sentinel regardless of supplied name; nonempty append links new node before checking missing name, preserving partial publication. load initializes current/rings only when list exists, traverses selected live count, leaves fallback path uninitialized, publishes partial fread bytes over previous encoded data, ignores complete-item return and then closes. Enumeration creates sentinel before search, preserves provider order/time, opens even rejected slots, publishes every partial read, validates full-item/nonzero slot<100/CRC before append, caps at 99 and closes file before next/search-close. List node/name allocation and retained aliases are not equivalent to unrestricted CRT heap lifetime, and malformed/missing resource boundaries are explicit failures rather than fabricated success.
